fusions.name: Twin Edicts
fusions.desc: Spits 2 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and stunning the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Command to Kneel
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Call to Court
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Crown of Reeds
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next 2 spells deal 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
